notes: Confirm grade levels, cost and dates when the 2027 page is posted. Another UC camp, the Early IT Summer Camp, has its own card in this guide.
name: UC Summer Engineering Camps (Young and Rising Engineers)
org: University of Cincinnati College of Engineering and Applied Science
what_you_do: Day camps on the Clifton campus from 9 am to 4 pm. Camps are grouped by age and skill level. The 2026 form named Young Engineers and Rising Engineers camps.
who_can_apply: Camps are organized by age and interest level. Grade rules and fees are not stated on the pages read.
pay_detail: A fee applies; the amount is not stated on the pages read. Scholarships may be available for students who need financial help.
duration: Day camps; length not stated on the pages read
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed and late applications were not accepted. Sign up for the interest list to hear about 2027 camps.
how_to_apply: Join the interest list on the UC summer camps page. Then apply when 2027 sign up opens. Email CEASSummerCamps@ucmail.uc.edu.
